name: Fastify
database_layer: @fastify/postgres 6.1 (node-postgres 8.23 pool), DB_POOL_SIZE / BENCH_WORKERS connections per process
logging: none (Fastify's logger is off by default)

phase2.validation: JSON schemas for params, querystring and bodies (Ajv; the PUT body without type coercion): 400

csrf.mechanism: @fastify/csrf-protection 8 with @fastify/cookie (secret in the _csrf cookie, token in the _csrf field)

session.mechanism: @fastify/secure-session 8 (libsodium secretbox), key shared by the cluster processes
